translations.name: Connections to Success
translations.description: Free career training, personal development classes, mentoring, and ongoing support to help you get and keep a stable job. Women in the program can also get free interview and work clothes and career coaching through Dress for Success Kansas City.
translations.warning: Call or use the website's contact form to check program availability. Free work clothes through Dress for Success require a referral from Connections to Success or a partner agency.
translations.website_description: Free job training, mentoring, and work clothes to help you find stable work in the Kansas City area.
